thread:
sam: Quick FYI 1 Sydra Beta is GA in Hosted :tada: new endpoint /v2/sydra-stream supports streaming, structured tool-calls, and adaptive KV caching. Rolling over 48h. Please read migration notes before switching production traffic.

leo: Awesome. Does this change any quotas or billing?

sam: No quota changes today. We added a per-tool usage meter so customers can see cost per tool in Console. Billing model remains per-token + per-tool-meter.

deploy-bot: deploy sydra/hosted -> success (regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1) :rocket:

sre-oncall: Any perf regressions to watch? Need to update SLO runbooks if spans/names change.

sam: Microbenchmarks: p50 token latency similar, p95 +5ms at long sequences when callbacks are enabled. KV reuse reduces end-to-end cost for multi-turn chat. Perf doc: https://intranet.redwood.dev/perf/sydra (internal).

tia: Are SDKs released?

sam: JS & Python SDKs published: `@redwood/sydra v1.0.0` and `redwood_sydra==1.0.0`. They include helpers to register tools and parse streaming frames. Example curl in docs.

security-bot: Reminder: outbound callbacks require registering callback domains and enabling KMS for any secrets. Follow security policy: https://intranet.redwood.dev/security/callbacks.

product: Marketing want a one-pager + short blog. Can we delay external announcement by 5 days to gather early feedback?

sam: Yep - internal only for 5 days. I'll post product brief and screenshots to #marketing and #docs today.

ops: Migration checklist (pinned): 1) Request canary key if testing 2) Upgrade SDK 3) Swap endpoint to /v2/sydra-stream 4) Register tools with SDK helper 5) Watch new metrics `sydra.tool_calls` and `sydra.stream.frames`.

sam: Thanks all. If you hit issues ping `@sre-oncall` or open a thread in #release-war-room. Will update with the customer FAQ and migration script shortly.
